# TraceRazor

> Offline auditor for AI-agent token waste: scores a reasoning trace with a Token Alignment Score (0–100), decomposes the waste into named signals, and emits risk-tagged fix patches with estimated savings — no API keys, deterministic, cryptographically verifiable.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZulfaqarHafez/tracerazor/main/README.md): Project overview, install, the audit→apply→measure→verify loop, and the metric catalog.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZulfaqarHafez/tracerazor/main/AGENTS.md): Cross-agent convention — when to reach for TraceRazor, command reference, the exit-code contract, and the honesty rules.
- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZulfaqarHafez/tracerazor/main/docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md): The single machine-oriented end-to-end recipe — locate/convert input per source, audit, and interpret every report field.
- [Trace format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZulfaqarHafez/tracerazor/main/docs/trace-format.md): The native trace format, supported source formats, and validation rules.
- [Trace JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZulfaqarHafez/tracerazor/main/schemas/trace.schema.json): Machine-readable schema for a native input trace.
- [Report JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZulfaqarHafez/tracerazor/main/schemas/report.schema.json): Machine-readable schema for the `audit --format json` report output.
- [Python API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZulfaqarHafez/tracerazor/main/docs/python_api.md): The `tracerazor` package — `Tracer`, client, report objects, and sampling helpers.
- [TRICE library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZulfaqarHafez/tracerazor/main/docs/trice_library.md): The pure-Python deterministic context-control library and its public contract.
- [MCP server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZulfaqarHafez/tracerazor/main/docs/MCP.md): Running TraceRazor as a Model Context Protocol server (`tracerazor-mcp`) for MCP-capable agents.
- [Claude Code skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZulfaqarHafez/tracerazor/main/skills/tracerazor/SKILL.md): The distributable skill definition — trigger phrases and the step-by-step audit workflow.
- [Comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZulfaqarHafez/tracerazor/main/COMPARISON.md): Honest positioning against observability/cost-tracking platforms.
- [Case study](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZulfaqarHafez/tracerazor/main/docs/case_study.md): A measured, live before/after run — estimated savings turned into measured deltas.
- [Metric effectiveness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZulfaqarHafez/tracerazor/main/docs/metric_effectiveness.md): The self-evaluation behind the composite — which metrics are kept vs demoted to diagnostics, and why.
